title: Claude partial outage
summary: Anthropic's Claude AI service experienced a partial outage as reported on their official status page, with a corresponding Hacker News discussion attracting 30 points and 9 comments from users reporting service disruptions.
problem_solved: This incident report documents and tracks service availability issues for Claude AI users and affected applications.
why_valuable: Provides transparency about AI service reliability and helps users understand when and why AI services may be unavailable.
